text: What's everyone's favourite arc in Demon Slayer? Mugen Train still hits the hardest for me. Rengoku deserved better.
BLACKPINK's new song is amazing! Who else is listening on repeat? The dance break is unreal.
Just finished Elden Ring... what a masterpiece! Any similar games you'd recommend?
This week's One Piece chapter though. Oda really said no breaks this year.
Hot take: Gojo is the best-written overpowered character in modern anime. Fight me.
Rewatched Dune: Part Two in IMAX and the sandworm scene is still the best thing I've seen in a cinema.
Starting Arcane for the first time tonight. Everyone says I'm going to cry. Is that true?
Looking for a starting point for X-Men. So many runs! Where did you all begin?
